text: The Carter family, towing a trailer to Los Angeles, [is stranded in the Nevada desert|trigger|cut off and trapped] while their dogs bark at the hills. Out there lives Papa Jupiter, [a boy left to die by his own father|origin|harm done in childhood], with the sons he raised to eat travellers. The family's night becomes a siege of fire and abduction as the clan [carries off the baby Katy to eat|wrong|harm done to children], and the surviving Carters learn to [fight back with traps and guns|ending|victims become the evil].
